opportunities.title: Rwanda Electrical Services Web Platform
opportunities.description: I’m launching an online business that lets people in Rwanda book trusted electricians from their phone or laptop. The core service menu will cover: • Home wiring and brand-new installations • Electrical repairs and fault-finding My main audiences are homeowners & renters who need quick fixes and construction companies or property owners looking for larger installation work. What I need you to build is a responsive web platform—website or lightweight web app—where visitors can: • Select the type of job, describe the issue, upload photos if helpful • Enter location, preferred date and time, and contact details • Receive an instant quote or booking confirmation • Pay easily through local options such as Mobile Money, cards, or bank transfer • Track the job status in a simple customer dashboard On my side I want an admin panel to view all requests, assign or reassign technicians, update progress, and send automated email/SMS/WhatsApp notifications. Deliverables 1. Complete front-end and back-end code (any modern stack you’re comfortable with—WordPress + plugins, Laravel, Django, or React/Node are all fine as long as the final product is secure and scalable). 2. Clean, mobile-first UI with basic branding elements (logo, colour palette, service icons). 3. Admin dashboard with role-based access (owner, dispatcher, electrician). 4. Payment gateway integration tested in Rwanda. 5. Short setup manual or screen-share walkthrough so I can manage the site myself. If you’ve built service-booking platforms before, especially in emerging markets, tell me which tools you prefer and show a live link or screenshots. I’m ready to move quickly once I find the right partner.

opportunities.title: Especialista en Meta Ads y Marketing Digital para Captación de Clie...
opportunities.description: Somos **Eliel Parfum**, una empresa mexicana dedicada a la comercialización de perfumes originales al mayoreo. Buscamos un profesional con experiencia en **Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram), marketing digital y generación de clientes potenciales** que nos ayude a aumentar nuestras ventas mediante estrategias publicitarias efectivas. Actualmente contamos con un proceso comercial que incluye publicidad digital, formularios, landing page y atención a clientes por WhatsApp. Queremos trabajar con alguien que pueda analizar este proceso, identificar oportunidades y ayudarnos a mejorar los resultados. **¿Qué buscamos?** - Experiencia comprobable gestionando campañas de Facebook e Instagram Ads. - Conocimiento de estrategias de generación de leads y adquisición de clientes. - Capacidad para identificar audiencias interesadas en comprar al mayoreo. - Experiencia optimizando embudos de conversión y campañas publicitarias. - Conocimiento de Meta Pixel, Conversions API y herramientas de medición. - Capacidad para interpretar métricas y tomar decisiones basadas en resultados. - Familiaridad con herramientas de inteligencia artificial aplicadas al marketing digital. **¿Qué esperamos del profesional?** Nos interesa encontrar a alguien que pueda involucrarse estratégicamente en nuestro proyecto, comprender nuestro modelo de negocio y proponer mejoras. Nuestro objetivo no es simplemente generar contactos, sino conseguir **personas realmente interesadas en convertirse en compradores mayoristas recurrentes**. Valoramos especialmente a profesionales que hayan trabajado con empresas de comercio electrónico, negocios B2B o proyectos enfocados en generación de ventas. **¿Qué ofrecemos?** Buscamos establecer una colaboración profesional con posibilidades de continuidad, dependiendo de los resultados y el desarrollo del proyecto. Estamos abiertos a escuchar propuestas de trabajo, metodologías y presupuestos. **Para postularte:** Cuéntanos brevemente qué experiencia tienes gestionando campañas de Meta Ads, qué resultados has conseguido y cómo abordarías un proyecto como el nuestro. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Publicidad en Google, Facebook ¿Qué necesitas?: Campañas de complejidad media

Café Borbón Rosado Tostado y Molido a Medida**: Entregamos en grano entero o con el **nivel exacto de molienda** (fina espresso, media V60/Chemex/filtro, gruesa prensa francesa) y **curva de tostión** (clara, media o media-oscura) que requiera su empresa o cliente (presentaciones de 250g, 500g y bolsas institucionales por kilos con válvula desgasificadora).

🏅 **3. Calidad Garantizada**: Perfil dulce, limpio, notas a panela, melocotón y flor de café, libre de defectos primarios.

opportunities.title: Ghostwriter y Editor Profesional para Colección de 3 Libros
opportunities.organization: Cliente I. I. D. L. F. (Estados Unidos)
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional con experiencia en escritura fantasma, copywriting y edición para desarrollar una colección de tres libros. Estos libros estarán dirigidos a un público diverso que incluye padres de familia, maestros y profesionales de la salud. El objetivo principal es transformar clases grabadas, entrevistas y otros materiales existentes en textos profesionales y atractivos. El freelancer seleccionado deberá ser capaz de escribir de manera clara y cercana, manteniendo la voz, el estilo y la metodología del autor original. Además, se requerirá apoyo en la edición de los manuscritos para asegurar que estén pulidos y listos para ser entregados a una editorial externa. Se valora la disponibilidad inmediata para comenzar el proyecto esta misma semana. Los interesados deben enviar su portafolio de libros en los que hayan participado, detallar su experiencia específica en ghostwriting y edición de desarrollo, así como sus honorarios y metodología de trabajo. También se solicita un presupuesto para una primera etapa que incluya la estructura editorial y un capítulo de muestra. Categoría: Redacción y Traducción Subcategoría: Otros Tamaño del proyecto: Grande

opportunities.title: Industrial Commercial Interior Design - 04/11/2026 14:15 EST
opportunities.description: I’m outfitting a commercial space and want it to communicate a raw, industrial vibe from the moment someone walks through the door. Concrete textures, exposed services, steel, and a muted, masculine palette are the look I’m after—not polished corporate chic. Even though it’s a business premises, the layout is broken into zones that mirror residential functions: • a relaxed lounge-style area (my “Living room”) • an open pantry/café corner (“Kitchen”) • a set of quiet retreat pods (“Bedroom”) • one additional zone I’ve labeled “Bhaskar,” which is essentially a flexible breakout space. Your task is to translate those four zones into a cohesive industrial interior scheme. I need: 1. Concept mood boards capturing materials, lighting, colour and furniture direction. 2. Scaled layout plans that show circulation and zoning. 3. At least two high-quality 3D renders per zone so stakeholders can visualise the concept. 4. A concise material and furniture schedule with retail or trade sources. Please base all drawings on standard commercial codes (fire exits, accessibility, etc.). I’ll supply the CAD shell, measurements and brand guidelines as soon as we start. Deliver everything in editable formats—preferred tools are AutoCAD/Revit for plans and SketchUp/Lumion/3ds Max for visuals, but I’m open if you use equivalents and can export DWG and high-resolution JPEG/PNG. I’ll approve the concept once mood boards and a single render for each zone match the brief; the remaining assets follow after sign-off. Looking forward to seeing your industrial imagination at work.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40803113, publicado hace 5 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 1,250 - 2,500.

opportunities.title: Realistic AI Workplace Dispute Scene
opportunities.description: I need a short, self-contained video—five minutes or less—that shows two AI-generated, realistic human characters arguing over a workplace issue. I am providing the script. The audience simply watches; there are no interactive choices or alternate endings. You’re free to choose the production pipeline you prefer (Unreal Engine + MetaHuman, Reallusion iClone, Blender with AI voice-synthesis, etc.) so long as the finished characters look convincingly human, speak with natural-sounding voices, and display believable facial expressions and body language throughout the dispute. The argument itself should feel authentic to an office setting: think clashing opinions on project ownership, missed deadlines, or resource allocation. Implied backstory is fine, but keep the pacing tight so the tension is clear and the scene resolves within the time limit. Acceptance criteria: • 1080p (or higher) video file, max 5 min • Two fully voiced, lip-synced, realistic characters in a continuous scene • Script/dialogue transcript and any audio stems • Source project files or assets needed for future edits, with proof of license for any paid content If this fits your skill set, let me know which tools you plan to use and how long you’ll need to deliver the first cut.

opportunities.title: Automation Test Engineer — O1D Match Platform | Global Talent Opportunities & O-1 Visa Petition Sponsorship Pathway -- 2
opportunities.description: # Automation Test Engineer — O1D Match Platform | Global Talent Opportunities & O-1 Visa Petition Sponsorship Pathway **Company:** O1D Match **Website:** https://o1dmatch.com **Location:** Remote — Open to Qualified Professionals Worldwide **Compensation:** $25–$300+ per hour, based on experience and project requirements **Engagement:** Freelance / Contract / Potential Long-Term Collaboration ### About O1D Match O1D Match is a global talent platform connecting exceptional professionals with meaningful opportunities while helping qualified individuals explore U.S. O-1 visa petition sponsorship through an agent-based model. **We welcome talented professionals from every country. There are no nationality-based restrictions on applying.** Unlike traditional recruiting platforms, O1D Match combines professional opportunities, talent assessments, career development, and access to an immigration petition pathway for eligible individuals. Through our network of U.S. agent-petitioners and immigration professionals, qualified candidates may be able to pursue an O-1 visa petition supported by legitimate professional engagements. We are building the technology behind this platform and are looking for talented engineers to help us improve, test, and scale O1D Match itself. ### The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced **Automation Test Engineer specializing in Playwright, Cypress, and modern web application testing**. This is an opportunity to contribute directly to the development and reliability of O1D Match. Our platform includes candidate registration, AI-powered professional assessments, talent matching, educational resources, profile management, and workflows supporting potential O-1 visa petition arrangements. We need an engineer who can help ensure these systems work reliably from beginning to end. ### What You Will Work On **1. Candidate Registration and Onboarding** - Automate testing of account creation, login, and authentication. - Verify candidate profile creation and document uploads. - Test onboarding workflows and navigation between platform features. - Identify errors that prevent candidates from completing registration. **2. AI-Powered Talent Assessments** - Test the candidate skills assessment interface. - Verify that questions, responses, and results are properly recorded. - Test edge cases, incomplete submissions, and failed requests. - Identify problems affecting assessment reliability and candidate experience. - Verify appropriate error handling and privacy controls. **3. Talent Matching and Professional Profiles** - Test candidate dashboards and professional profile workflows. - Verify search, filtering, and matching-related functionality as implemented. - Test application status updates and notifications. - Identify issues with data consistency and platform navigation. **4. O-1 Education and Petition-Related Workflows** - Test navigation between O1D Match and its educational resources. - Verify forms and candidate-facing eligibility assessment workflows. - Test document-upload and profile-management features. - Review technical functionality supporting professional opportunity and agent-petitioner processes. **5. Automated Testing Infrastructure** - Develop automated tests using Playwright or Cypress. - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. - Build reusable regression tests. - Produce actionable bug reports, logs, and screenshots. - Help our development team prevent recurring issues. ### Required Qualifications - 3+ years of software testing or test automation experience. - Strong experience with Playwright or Cypress. - JavaScript or TypeScript proficiency. - Experience testing React or Next.js applications. - Knowledge of APIs, authentication, and databases. - Familiarity with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD tools. - Ability to test independently and produce clear technical documentation. Experience with Supabase, AI-powered applications, Stripe, or SaaS platforms is particularly valuable. ### O-1 Visa Petition Sponsorship Opportunities **O1D Match is more than a freelance platform. We also help exceptional international professionals explore U.S. O-1 visa petition opportunities.** The O-1 visa is intended for individuals who demonstrate extraordinary ability or achievement in qualifying fields. For eligible professionals, an authorized U.S. agent may be able to file an O-1 petition based on qualifying professional engagements and appropriate supporting evidence. Through O1D Match, candidates can: - Learn about O-1 eligibility requirements. - Complete an initial assessment of their professional achievements. - Create a professional profile. - Explore potential projects and professional engagements. - Learn about U.S. agent-petitioner arrangements. - Be considered for appropriate petition-related services if independently eligible. **Applicants do not need to be from any particular country, and O-1 eligibility is not required to apply for this freelance role.** However, immigration petition sponsorship is not automatic. Any potential petition requires a separate eligibility review, qualifying work arrangements, a suitable petitioner, and compliance with applicable immigration requirements. ### Learn How O1D Match Works We encourage candidates to explore our free 12-part educational video course. **Free O1D Match Educational Course:** https://educate.o1dmatch.com The videos explain how the platform operates, how O-1 eligibility is evaluated, and how the agent-petitioner model works. ### Mandatory Candidate Skills Assessment **IMPORTANT: EVERY APPLICANT MUST COMPLETE THE O1D MATCH SKILLS ASSESSMENT TO BE CONSIDERED.** Our AI-assisted skills assessment helps evaluate technical experience, professional capabilities, and potential suitability for platform development projects. The assessment includes approximately eight practical questions and generally takes less than 10 minutes. **Required assessment website:** https://workwithus.o1dmatch.com Applicants must: 1. Create their candidate profile. 2. Select their professional skills and areas of expertise. 3. Complete the required skills assessment. 4. Provide relevant portfolio or project examples. **No candidate will be considered for selection without completing the assessment. Submitting a proposal or portfolio alone is not sufficient.** Candidates applying through Freelancer.com must also comply with that platform's applicable communication and recruitment policies. ### Compensation and Work Arrangement **Compensation: $25–$300+ per hour**, depending on the complexity of the work, qualifications, and agreed project terms. - Fully remote opportunities. - Open to qualified professionals worldwide. - Flexible scheduling based on project requirements. - Short-term and potentially ongoing assignments. - Opportunities to contribute directly to the O1D Match platform. ### Why Join O1D Match? We are building an international network of talented professionals who want to contribute to meaningful technology projects while expanding their professional opportunities. This position offers the possibility of building technology that other talented professionals will use to advance their careers. You will have the opportunity to contribute to a growing global talent platform, work alongside technology professionals, and potentially develop an ongoing relationship with O1D Match. ### Apply Now **Complete your mandatory assessment:** https://workwithus.o1dmatch.com **Explore the O1D Match platform:** https://o1dmatch.com **Watch our educational videos:** https://educate.o1dmatch.com **Applications without a completed skills assessment will not be considered.** *Disclaimer: Completion of the assessment or participation in freelance projects does not guarantee selection, future engagements, O-1 visa eligibility, petition sponsorship, immigration approval, or authorization to work in the United States. Any O-1 petition arrangement is subject to an independent eligibility determination, proper documentation, and applicable immigration laws.*

opportunities.title: WhatsApp FAQ Auto-Responder Setup
opportunities.description: Necesito que mi canal de WhatsApp responda en automático las preguntas frecuentes de mis clientes. La prioridad inicial son las dudas sobre precios, productos y servicios; todo debe resolverse sin intervención humana, salvo que la pregunta se salga de lo habitual. Ya dispongo de la información publicada en mi sitio web y en redes sociales: ese será el insumo que el asistente usará como base de conocimiento. No poseo un documento de preguntas y respuestas predefinidas, por lo que el flujo debe extraer, resumir y presentar los datos directamente desde esas fuentes de forma confiable. Entrego acceso a la cuenta de WhatsApp Business y a las URLs necesarias. Espero que configures la integración (API de WhatsApp Business, Twilio, Meta Cloud API o la herramienta que domines) y entrenes el modelo o lógica conversacional para que: • Detecte automáticamente solicitudes sobre precios, catálogos y características de producto • Devuelva una respuesta clara al instante usando la información vigente del sitio o las redes • Registre las consultas en un reporte simple para análisis posterior • Ofrezca la opción de escalar a un agente humano cuando no encuentre respuesta Como resultado final, quiero el sistema activo, probado con al menos 20 interacciones de muestra y un breve documento donde expliques cómo actualizar la base de conocimiento cuando cambien mis precios o lanzamientos de productos.

opportunities.title: Concertador de Reuniones PyME
opportunities.description: Necesito apoyo externo para realizar llamadas en frío con un objetivo muy concreto: conseguir citas con posibles clientes de pequeñas y medianas empresas. ¿Qué espero de tu trabajo? • Llamar a los contactos que facilitaré y, si lo prefieres, complementar la base de datos con tus propios hallazgos. • Detectar rápidamente necesidades, presentar nuestra solución de forma clara y cerrar una fecha y hora para la reunión. • Registrar cada intento de contacto, resultado de la llamada y próximas acciones en un breve reporte compartido (puede ser en Excel, Google Sheets o CRM si ya utilizas uno). Tono y recursos Te daré un guion inicial y material de referencia; confío en que puedas adaptarlo con tu estilo para generar conversación y maximizar el interés. El trato debe ser profesional y cercano, propio del mundo B2B. Plazos y volumen No hay límite de tiempo estricto: prefiero calidad sobre velocidad, así que podrás organizar tu agenda siempre que mantengas un flujo constante de citas confirmadas. Entregables mínimos 1. Agenda semanal de reuniones confirmadas con datos de contacto. 2. Informe de llamadas detallando número marcado, resultado y observaciones clave. Si tienes experiencia concertando reuniones en el mercado PyME y disfrutas persuadiendo por teléfono, me encantará conocer tu propuesta y disponibilidad.

opportunities.title: IT Services Lead Generator Needed
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a skilled lead-generation specialist who already knows how to sell IT services and can prove it. Your task is simple and focused: bring me qualified prospects specifically interested in custom software development and business-process automation. The contacts you source must be business owners or founders who have the authority to start a new project or green-light a discovery call. I’m open on company size and industry, as long as the pain point revolves around streamlining operations, replacing legacy tools, or building new digital products. What you’ll deliver • A spreadsheet (or CRM import) with fresh, verified leads: name, company, role, email, LinkedIn profile, and a short note on their automation or software need. • At least one clear buying signal per lead—recent funding, public hiring for tech roles, a stated interest in upgrading systems, etc. • Weekly progress updates so I can adjust messaging or targeting fast. Acceptance criteria 1. Minimum 90 % email validity (zero hard bounces). 2. Leads match the decision-maker and service focus described above. 3. First batch of 25 sample leads due within three days for review before scaling. If you’ve closed deals for custom development before and have the outreach tools—LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Hunter, Skrapp, any reliable email sequencing platform—let’s talk. Show me a brief outline of your approach and one example of a successful campaign you ran in this space.

opportunities.title: Script-to-Upload YouTube Videos
opportunities.description: I have a library of finished scripts and I want each one turned into a complete YouTube video that is ready to drop straight into YouTube Studio the moment you send it back. From voice-over and background music to stock or AI-generated visuals, lower thirds, and a clean outro, everything needs to be stitched together automatically so I can focus solely on writing the next script. I’m open to whatever production stack you’re most comfortable with—whether that’s Premiere Pro automation, After Effects with expressions, Final Cut scripting, ffmpeg, or a custom Python workflow—as long as the result is a polished 1080p (or better) file that needs no further tweaks on my end. If you already have templates or an AI pipeline that speeds things up, even better. Turnaround time is critical; I’d like to see the first automated sample video as soon as possible so we can lock in the look and pacing before batching the rest. When you reply, point me to past projects that demonstrate you can take a raw script and deliver a finished video, outline the experience that makes you the right fit, and walk me through your proposed approach so I can see how quickly we can scale this.

opportunities.title: Polish Corporate Canva Video
opportunities.description: **Canva Video Editor Needed to Polish an Existing Corporate Video** I’m looking for an experienced video editor to improve an existing corporate video for I-TEK, a company working in winemaking equipment, industrial plants and automation. The video is nearly two minutes long and has already been assembled in Canva using clips from Canva’s video library. I will share the editable Canva project. I’m looking for someone with a strong visual eye who can take the current edit to a professional corporate standard. The work includes improving the pacing and flow, choosing smooth and purposeful transitions, refining the text and typography, and making the colours, music and overall style feel consistent. You may rearrange scenes or replace weaker clips with better options from Canva’s library where it improves the result. I want a polished, engaging film that communicates the quality and scale of our work. It should look professional even when watched without sound. Please send examples of corporate videos you have edited, ideally in Canva, along with your estimated price and turnaround time. The final deliverables should be the **editable Canva project** and a **high-quality exported video**.

opportunities.title: Agentes Telemercadeo Seguros
opportunities.description: Necesito incorporar cinco agentes en mi equipo para impulsar la venta de seguros a empresas de cualquier tamaño. El trabajo consiste en contactar a prospectos exclusivamente por llamada telefónica, presentarles nuestra propuesta y cerrar la venta; el proceso de agendamiento y la promoción de servicios contables complementarios quedarán como pasos secundarios una vez establecida la conversación. Requisitos esenciales • Español nativo o nivel profesional. • Disponibilidad de lunes a viernes en horario laboral; necesito cobertura continua, no turnos parciales. • Experiencia previa en televentas o call-center, idealmente dentro del sector seguros. Herramientas y soporte Proporciono base de datos de leads, guion de ventas, CRM basado en la nube y capacitación inicial. Cada agente tendrá usuario propio para registrar llamadas, notas y resultados en tiempo real. Entregables y métricas – Registro diario de llamadas realizadas, contactos efectivos y pólizas vendidas. – Seguimiento en el CRM con notas claras y estatus actualizado al cierre de la jornada. – Reporte semanal resumido (exportación del CRM) para revisar tasa de conversión y oportunidades abiertas. Criterio de aceptación: los datos en el CRM deben coincidir con las llamadas salientes y reflejar, como mínimo, el 100 % de los leads asignados contactados dentro de la semana hábil correspondiente. Si cuentas con disponibilidad total, excelente dicción y la motivación para cumplir objetivos de venta, estaré encantado de revisar tu propuesta y coordinar una breve llamada de inducción.

opportunities.title: Agentes Ventas Telefónicas LATAM
opportunities.description: Necesito incorporar varios agentes de call center que se encuentren en cualquier país de Latinoamérica y que puedan marcar a clientes en Estados Unidos durante el horario comercial de ese país. El trabajo es 100 % de ventas de productos o servicios; provisto el guion, la base de datos y el CRM, tu misión será convertir contactos interesados en clientes efectivos hablando principalmente en español Para que funcione desde el primer día requiero experiencia comprobable en: • Ventas por teléfono a clientes en Estados Unidos • Telemarketing y manejo de objeciones • Call center de atención al cliente y ventas El flujo de trabajo será sencillo: al inicio de cada jornada recibirás tu lista de leads; al cierre, cargarás al CRM el resultado de cada llamada y un breve resumen de objeciones y cierres logrados. Con eso generaremos un reporte diario y mediremos tus conversiones. Si cuentas con un buen acento neutro en español, conexión estable y la disponibilidad para ajustar tu horario al de EE. UU., estarás listo para arrancar. En tu propuesta indícame tu experiencia en campañas similares y la franja horaria en la que puedes trabajar.

opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan bantuan untuk menciptakan sebuah animasi 3D berdurasi singkat yang dirancang khusus untuk konten media sosial. Fokusnya adalah video edukasi—padat, informatif, dan tetap menarik agar penonton bertahan hingga akhir. Apa yang saya butuhkan: • Konsep visual berdasarkan materi edukasi yang akan saya sediakan (tema, poin-poin utama, dan tone). • Storyboard sederhana untuk memastikan alur dan timing sudah pas sebelum produksi penuh. • Model, rigging, lighting, dan texturing secukupnya guna mendukung cerita—tidak harus hiper-realistis, yang penting jelas dan estetik. • Animasi 3D final dengan durasi ±30–60 detik, lengkap dengan basic sound effects dan background music bebas lisensi. • File akhir dalam format MP4 (1080×1080 atau 1080×1350 untuk feed dan reel), plus file proyek asli (Blender, Maya, atau software pilihan Anda) sebagai arsip. Harapan kualitas: – Gerakan halus dan ekspresif. – Warna dan pencahayaan konsisten serta ramah layar ponsel. – Teks atau call-out jika diperlukan agar pesan cepat tersampaikan dalam beberapa detik pertama. Saya terbuka mendiskusikan gaya—apakah lebih kartun, semi-realistis, atau flat minimalis—asal tetap cocok untuk audiens media sosial. Setelah menerima draft pertama, saya menyediakan satu kali revisi mayor dan satu kali revisi minor untuk penyesuaian akhir. Bila Anda berpengalaman membuat animasi 3D singkat yang engaging untuk Instagram, TikTok, atau platform sejenis, saya menantikan portofolio Anda dan estimasi waktu pengerjaan.

opportunities.title: 3D Print & Assemble Handheld
opportunities.description: I already have all the electronic modules, batteries, and wiring for a small handheld device; what’s missing is the physical shell and the final build-out. Your job is to take my measurements and sketches, turn them into a clean, functional 3-D model, print the parts, and seat the electronics securely inside. Here’s what the finished casing must accomplish: it needs to hold and protect the boards, battery, and wiring, plus expose the required buttons, indicator LEDs, and a USB-C port without snagging or wobble. I expect the unit to feel solid in the hand, with tolerances tight enough for daily handling. The workflow I have in mind • Translate my rough dimensions and reference photos into a printable CAD design (Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or comparable software are all fine). • Check clearances for the PCB stack, buttons, and port cut-outs, then send me a quick visual or screen-share for approval before printing. • Recommend an appropriate material—PLA+ is acceptable for early proofs, but I’d like the final version in something tougher such as PETG, ABS, or a nylon blend. • Print the enclosure, test-fit the electronics, make any minor tweaks, then complete the final print run. • Assemble and verify that power comes up, buttons click cleanly, and the USB-C jack seats firmly. • Ship the fully assembled prototype (or hand it off locally if you’re nearby) along with the STL/CAD files and any machining notes. Acceptance criteria 1. All electronics mounted without rattle or movement. 2. Buttons and port align within ±0.2 mm of design spec. 3. No visible layer separation or warping in the final enclosure. 4. Delivered source files match the printed revision. If this sounds straightforward and you have a reliable printer plus solid soldering or small-parts assembly skills, let’s get started—I’m ready to move quickly once the design is locked in.

opportunities.title: Gmail Automation & Templates
opportunities.description: I need my Gmail account turned into a smooth, self-running system. The first task is to build professional email templates and set up automatic replies so I can respond consistently without typing the same messages over and over. My larger goal is to link Gmail with another service—whether that’s a CRM, a project-management tool, or a marketing platform—so data moves instantly between systems. If you’re comfortable with Zapier, Google Workspace Add-ons, or Apps Script, let me know; I’m open to the method that delivers reliable two-way syncing. Finally, I want my inbox to clean itself. Create smart filters and automatic sorting rules that label incoming mail exactly where it belongs. By the end, I should see new messages drop into the right folders without any manual drag-and-drop. Key deliverables: • Ready-to-use email templates plus auto-reply rules • Seamless integration connecting Gmail to the external tool/service • A complete set of filters with labels for hands-free inbox organization • A brief hand-off guide so I can tweak things later if needed If you have a proven track record scripting or automating Gmail, I’d love to hear how you’d tackle this.

opportunities.title: Modern Café Website Development
opportunities.description: I need a visually striking yet simple website that captures the look and feel of my café while making it effortless for guests to find us, browse our menu, and get in touch. The build should include four core pages—Home, About, Menu, and Contact—with a clean navigation flow and a responsive layout that works seamlessly on phones, tablets, and desktops. Key features I expect: • A photo-rich gallery that shows off our food, drinks, and atmosphere • A one-tap WhatsApp button so visitors can message us instantly • Google Maps embedded on the Contact page for accurate directions Design wise, I’m aiming for modern and elegant rather than cluttered, with plenty of room for high-quality images and concise copy. Performance, accessibility, and SEO best practices should be baked in from the start. Please send links to café or restaurant sites you’ve already launched, along with a brief outline of the tech stack or CMS you prefer for projects like this (WordPress, Webflow, custom code, etc.). Once I see your work, we can discuss the final scope and settle on milestones and budget. I’m ready to move quickly with the right developer.

opportunities.description: Busco a quien se encargue de la prospección outbound y la agenda de reuniones calificadas para mi cartera de cuentas industriales, manufactureras, de tecnología / software y de construcción. Qué necesito que hagas • Investigar y detectar decisores dentro de las empresas objetivo. • Contactarlos por e-mail, LinkedIn y, cuando aplique, teléfono o WhatsApp. • Calificar cada lead según nuestros criterios (tamaño de empresa, cargo, dolor detectado). • Agendar reuniones en mi calendario y entregar un breve resumen de contexto antes de cada llamada. Criterios de éxito • Número de reuniones calificadas agendadas por semana. • Calidad de la información capturada en el CRM (nombre, cargo, empresa, reto identificado). • Ratio de conversión de contacto a reunión confirmada. Lo que valoro en tu propuesta Muestra tu experiencia concreta haciendo prospección B2B outbound y comparte ejemplos o métricas de trabajos anteriores (p. ej., sectores atendidos, volumen de citas logradas, herramientas usadas). Si ya manejas HubSpot, Apollo, Lemlist o herramientas similares, coméntalo: agilizará la curva de aprendizaje. Entregables 1. Lista viva de leads contactados con estado actualizado. 2. Reporte semanal de actividad y resultados. 3. Reuniones calificadas en mi calendario según los objetivos pactados. Si te apasiona abrir puertas en los sectores industrial y tecnológico, quiero saber de ti.

opportunities.title: Panduan Raih Klien Freelancer
opportunities.description: Saya ingin sebuah panduan praktis yang menjelaskan langkah-demi-langkah bagaimana saya—atau freelancer mana pun—bisa menemukan dan mendapatkan klien lewat komunitas online, khususnya Grup Facebook dan WhatsApp. Fokus utama panduan: • Menemukan grup yang relevan dengan niche layanan saya. • Membangun kepercayaan di dalam grup tanpa terkesan “jualan” terus-menerus. • Teknik soft-selling: cara bertanya, menjawab, dan berbagi konten sehingga anggota grup tertarik menggunakan jasa saya. • Strategi DM (direct message) yang sopan tetapi efektif untuk mengonversi prospek menjadi klien. • Contoh skrip percakapan, template posting, dan daftar kata kunci yang dapat langsung saya salin-tempel. • Tips menjaga reputasi, menangani penolakan, serta mengamankan pembayaran pertama. Format akhir yang saya butuhkan: 1. Dokumen utama ±10-15 halaman (Google Docs atau Word) berisi panduan detail, studi kasus singkat, dan checklist tindakan harian. 2. Satu lembar ringkasan “cheat sheet” (PDF) yang mudah dicetak. 3. Bonus opsional namun dihargai: 3 visual sederhana (Canva) untuk contoh posting di Grup Facebook/WhatsApp. Pastikan bahasa tetap santai namun profesional, mudah dipahami pemula, dan relevan untuk pasar Indonesia. Saya akan menilai panduan dari kelengkapan langkah, kejelasan contoh, dan daya pakainya begitu selesai dibaca.

opportunities.title: Dashboard SEO en Data Studio
opportunities.description: Necesito un reporte personalizado en Looker Studio (antes Google Data Studio) que se conecte a Google Search Console y Google Analytics 4 para mostrar, de manera clara y visual, el desempeño SEO de mi sitio. Objetivo principal Quiero que cualquier cliente o miembro de dirección pueda abrir el dashboard y, en segundos, entender el progreso: posiciones de palabras clave, visibilidad en Google y tendencias clave a nivel geográfico. Alcance del trabajo • Configurar los conectores de Search Console y GA4. • Diseñar las páginas del informe con tablas, gráficos y filtros intuitivos. • Destacar métricas de posiciones, clics, impresiones, CTR y visibilidad según país o región. • Incluir un área de insights con interpretación de los datos y recomendaciones rápidas. • Entregarlo listo para compartirse mediante enlace con permisos de solo lectura. Formato y estilo El informe debe mantener los colores de mi marca (se los proporcionaré), usar lenguaje sencillo y contener secciones claramente diferenciadas para ejecutivos y para el equipo técnico. Qué valoro en tu propuesta Adjunta ejemplos de dashboards SEO que ya hayas creado; me ayudará a evaluar tu experiencia y enfoque visual. Si tienes preguntas sobre fuentes de datos, campos personalizados o cualquier otro detalle, házmelo saber para asegurarnos de que cubrimos todo antes de empezar.

opportunities.title: Mantenimiento Data Lake Azure + Pipelines Etl en Databricks
opportunities.description: Tenemos un DataLake montado en Azure con tres capas de explotación de datos Oro/Plata/Bronce. Dentro de la infraestructura tenemos una serie de Pipelines (ETL's) complejos que nos permiten generar una serie de informes. Buscamos un perfil que sea capaz de resolvernos varias incidencias que se han acumulado desde que montamos el DL con una empresa externa, que nos pueda hacer mantenimiento de la infraestructura, así como modificar los flujos y pipelines montados para afinar los informes diseñados. Como requisitos ha de tener conocimientos de: - Diseño y desarrollo de procesos etl/elt. - SQL avanzado. - PostgreSQL y optimización de consultas, índices, particiones y almacenamiento. - Modelado de datos para entornos analíticos. - Data Lakes con arquitecturas Bronze / Silver / Gold. - Orquestación de procesos con Airflow o herramientas similares. - Python para procesamiento y transformación de datos. - Experiencia con Azure y Databricks. opportunities.title: Urgent Hospital Revit LOD 350 Modelling
opportunities.description: Project Title: Urgent – Revit 2024 Architecture & Interior BIM Modelling | LOD 350 | Hospital Project start today BACE Design & Engineering is seeking an experienced BIM freelancer or team to develop Architecture and Interior Design models to LOD 350 for a hospital renovation project in Doha, Qatar. The scope covers 2,898 m² on one inpatient tower floor. Existing BIM models and supporting project information will be provided. This is a BIM production assignment; design responsibility remains with the project’s design team. Scope of Work - Develop the Architecture model, including walls, doors, windows, openings, hosted elements, and room names and numbers. - Develop the Interior Design model, including floor and wall finishes, ceilings and ceiling supports, kitchen equipment, fixtures, sanitary fixtures, and furniture. - Work from the supplied BIM models, drawings, and existing-condition references. - Link adjacent zones and other disciplines for coordination. - Resolve AR/ID clashes and review comments issued by BACE. - Populate required COBie and BIM database parameters. - Apply project worksets, naming conventions, shared parameters, and existing/demolition/new-construction phasing. - Raise RFIs for missing or conflicting information and support review submissions through approval. Software & Standards - Autodesk Revit 2024 — models must remain in this version. - Autodesk Navisworks 2024. - Compliance with the supplied project BEP, BIM Manual, EIR, and PWA BIM/CAD standards. - Hospital or healthcare BIM experience is strongly preferred. Qatar/PWA project experience is an advantage. Required Deliverables 1. Architecture and Interior Design models in RVT format. 2. One NWC export per model. 3. QA/QC checklist for each model. 4. Input-file register showing filenames, revisions, and dates. 5. Interim submission at approximately 50% completion, final submission, and subsequent comment closure. Programme — Immediate Availability Required The project’s LOD 350 submission is due on 8 November 2026, with vendor delivery required one day earlier, on 7 November 2026. Please confirm your immediate availability, team capacity, and earliest achievable completion date. State clearly whether you can meet this deadline. Review comments must be addressed within two working days. Not Included Design development or validation, engineering calculations, code compliance assessment, MEP or structural modelling, façade modelling, scanning, site attendance, model federation, clash-report preparation, and animations. 2D drawing extraction, LOD 400, and LOD 500 are excluded from the base scope. Please Include in Your Bid - Examples of comparable healthcare or renovation BIM projects. - Available team size, assigned roles, and CVs of the lead AR/ID modellers. - Proposed interim and final delivery dates. - Fixed lump-sum price in QAR, split between Architecture and Interior Design. - Optional prices for 2D drawing extraction per sheet and upgrading this zone to LOD 400. - Hourly variation rates by role. - Assumptions, exclusions, and clarification questions. Prices should exclude taxes and transfer fees and remain valid for 30 days. Payment follows LOD 350 submission approval, with detailed terms agreed at award. Changes outside the agreed scope will be assessed as variations; corrections arising from the freelancer’s errors are included. All coordination will be through BACE. Project files are confidential and will be shared with shortlisted applicants. Suggested Freelancer Skills: Autodesk Revit · BIM · 3D Modelling · Autodesk Navisworks · Architecture · Interior Design
